capabilities: Converts notes or selections into structured goal cards
Auto-generates daily tasks from goal sub-items
Awards bamboo coins and cultivation levels for completions
Logs daily activities in a nine-period timeline
Runs deep reviews with health scores and action plans
disambiguation: Not a game or fiction-writing tool; the xianxia cultivation theme is a progress narrative over a real goal and daily-task automation system.
extras: One-time buyout gated by an activation code; unactivated plugin shows a full-screen paywall. Pipeline runs fully local without internet; AI planning is an optional add-on on the user's own key. Includes price-increase history and WeChat-based purchase flow.
motivation: Author wanted a third way between form-filling tools and streak-based apps that hijack attention, inspired by Glushkov's OGAS applied to one person instead of a state.
problem: Obsidian has no self-running loop that turns rough notes into structured goals, daily tasks, and review feedback without manual shuffling between them.

relations.evidence: AI runs on your own API Key (DeepSeek by default, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint supported)

requires.name: One-time purchase activation code (early bird ¥69, regular ¥9999)
DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible API key for optional AI natural-language planning

summary: Chinese-style goal automation system that turns notes into structured goals, auto-dispatches daily tasks, and rewards completion with coins and cultivation realms.
